## Microsoft Rallies Post-Earnings on AI Growth and Margin Strength; Xbox Guides to FY2027 Recovery

MSFT's AI-driven earnings reaction keeps the enterprise AI adoption and margin expansion thesis intact; the Xbox FY2027 guide is a secondary read-through on consumer gaming recovery timing, not the primary thesis lever.

- MSFT shares rallied following earnings, with both outlets attributing the move to AI growth and margin strength.
- Xbox separately guided for a return to growth in fiscal year 2027.
- No specific revenue, margin, or EPS figure appears in the headlines — directional beat framing only.
- Both outlets confirm AI as the primary driver of the stock reaction, with the Xbox guide as a secondary signal.
